versions.content: If the configuration parameter V2xGnTxConfirmation is enabled, the V2xGn module shall provide information about the status of the transmission with an associated ID (generated by the V2xFac module and handed down to track the status of the packet) to the V2xBtp Module via the V2xBtp_TxConfirmation() callback.
